newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil forex reserves up $2.2 bln in July - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil forex reserves up $2.2 bln in July - paper.

text.p: Brazil's hard currency reserves rose $2.2 billion to $59.813 billion in the first 22 days of July, Gazeta Mercantil newspaper reported.
Gazeta, citing an unnamed Central Bank official, said the country has seen strong inflows of dollars despite recent stock market volatility.
Healthy Eurobond issuance this month by corporates and a 150 million pound sterling Eurobond issued by the Republic have contributed to the net inflow of dollars, the paper said.
It added that reserve levels would be supported in August by an estimated $1.2 billion expected to enter the country to pay for licenses to operate B Band cellular service.
